procedure:
Action; V/S/F; native rank9/base26RP through Cleric/Druid/Wizard Necromancy. Preserve the native120-foot/Instantaneous fields as source evidence. NEW optionA resolves YOUR/UPONDEATH as a prospective SELF-only pact, not a remote120-foot resurrection: the living caster arms their own identity. A currently Dead identity cannot newly cast/arm it. NEW the application is persistent, nonconcentration, until spent, successfully replaced, or lawfully ended. It grants no current HP/RP and consumes normal casting costs/cadence at arming.

NEW one active Eternal Pact family record per recipient identity. A later successful paid self-cast replaces the older unspent application without refund and without adding another return. Countering a new cast leaves an earlier independent pact intact. The first actual death after arming consumes the chosen application exactly once, including when its expression is suppressed or the return is blocked. A would-die prevention is not death, does not consume the pact and does not restore RP. Do not insert a return before the fatal event, its prevention windows and its actual body/remains consequences finish. Resolve actual death, Soul Bind conversion/Hunted Death and source body aftermath first; only then attempt this return. A suppression-skipped trigger is lost, not pending for later replay.

NEW at that single post-event checkpoint require the same willing dead identity, the actual original body/remains sufficient and viable for return at its existing location, legal physical placement, no occupied duplicate living identity, and every applicable identity/soul/return blocker. It reconstructs no missing body, regenerates no vital part and teleports no corpse. Unknown body, soul, consent or support data holds that branch; it does not count as success. Hunted Death has no routine RP-purchased exception here. An express final sacrifice or other actual absolute return bar wins. Independent return effects keep their own source gates; once one really returns the identity, all later attempts see an already-living identity and cannot create another body/resource award. This spell grants no priority over a specifically ordered source.

On a successful legal return only, assign normalHP1, clear current death-save counters/Stable deadline, preserve Wounds/Injuries, Corruption, intrinsic curses, debts, Hunt/KT/PT histories, actual gear custody, Dissonance/Refrain, turn markers, cooldowns and all spent non-RP uses. This assigned1HP is resurrection, not ordinary healing. Restore only the recipient's current effective NORMAL RP maximum, not an extra pool or historical larger maximum. Existing lethal tracks use the accepted protected living-collapse reconciliation; actual persistent immediately lethal afflictions still require their own procedure. Return creates no Action, Reaction, concentration, equipment pickup, spell preparation, rest or recovery opportunity.

NEW choose optionA recurrence transparently: after one successful legal return, a later legal paid self-cast can arm another pact. No unprinted daily/rest recurrence cap is imposed. A repeated death/return cycle would restore normal RP again only if every new death, consumed application, body/soul/consent and return gate genuinely succeeds; all non-RP debt/uses and paid history remain. This potentially powerful recurrence is an explicit balance/playtest hold, not balance approval. Return217 selects explicit advance consent with reaffirmation or withdrawal at the single post-death checkpoint. Consent is a participant choice permitted by DR9-Q14, not a discovered soul-ownership fact. The four new complete ordinary fixtures demonstrate successful return, actual paid repeatability with retained casting cadence/gear/tracks, refusal, and a competing already-living return rejection. In an actual scene, unknown independent body/custody/Hunt facts remain conditional and must never be inferred from a name or class.

NEW qualification of external evidence obligations (DR9-Q22B): the retained old actual-Hunt-admission and exotic soul/body/companion branches remain conditional. This does not supply an extraordinary Hunt exception or claim their campaigns occurred. The known source predicate still denies ordinary Pact return at Hunted Death. The accepted lethal-track rule remains exact: retained Exhaustion6 becomes protected living Unconscious collapse, no voluntary action/travel until lawfully reduced below6; retained Expedition6 stays in its own collapse; a fresh qualifying gain reevaluates the lethal endpoint. These rules grant no independent treatment or immunity. The ordinary successful procedure is not held awaiting an unrelated Hunt-capable action or a nonexistent exotic actor.

sharedRules.casting: All seven native routes are rank9, class level17 minimum, base26RP, Action and V/S/F. Use exactly each native class-school row, actual acquired repertoire/prepared set, source ability/PB, usable hands/voice/focus, current budgets, range/geometry and perception where stated. The four Power Word Kill placements do not grant four class modes. Generic upcast, foreign material requirements and familiar spell rules are not supplied. Preflight illegality spends nothing; an otherwise legal commitment pays costs, Action and source cadence before interruption, saves or hidden threshold checks. Threshold failure is a paid no-effect resolution, not a target-selection oracle.
sharedRules.costAndCadence: Use current SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES resolve-a-cast sequence: pre-cast Dissonance price surcharge, actual source discounts/mandatory extras, then chronological Refrain and base strain. Rank9 ordinary base strain is2. A Wizard first distinct prepared matrix family has0 BASE strain only; a repeat still pays its actual base strain and chronological Refrain. A different name resets consecutive-name Refrain but never refreshes a Wizard family exemption. Class Counterspell has its own rank1,3RP,INT+PB versus10+2*rank and recharge2; Wizard Arch Dispel is rank3,3RP, and versus a rank9 ongoing spell uses INT+PB versus19, not rank5 or the counter DC. Actual acquisition and perception remain necessary. No blanket promotion of a catalog sourceStatus to runtime availability.
sharedRules.death: KEEP the Core/Healing/Body/Lifecycle interfaces. Direct death is a life-state transition, with no damage packet, Wound/concentration save, HP-damage trigger or damage-immunity test. Do not manufacture numeric damage to implement it. Normal HP is retained as a ledger unless an exact state assignment changes it; actual death can coexist with positive recorded HP. Ordinary Death Ward is a positive-to-zero floor and does not prevent direct death. Actually acquired Ritual of Undeath Death Ward mode can intercept an eligible would-die event if body and all its real source gates pass. True would-die protections resolve before committing death; a successful protection is not death. Actual death ends concentration and invalidates temporary-HP holding, drops actually held equipment, closes actual temporary forms by their exact interface and preserves unique identity, wound/injury/debt/corruption/resource histories. Hunted Death and pending Soul Bind conversion follow committed death; no spell here supplies an exceptional Hunt return.
sharedRules.holds: Missing source acquisition, creature/lifecycle/body information, geometry, hearing, identity/soul eligibility or an actual required campaign prerequisite is never supplied by a spell name or high die roll. Hold the exact branch requiring it. A conditional authored geometry/profile fixture is not observed gameplay. No runtime, human-play, playtest, numerical-balance, cosmology-canon, domain-closure or release approval is given.
sharedRules.information: Full authored state is audit data, not a player/controller visibility grant. No hidden HP preview, exact-HP failure explanation, hidden listener list, allegiance revelation, soul-location knowledge or debug-state access is granted. Fix declared modes, targets and recipient ordering before outcome data; no post-check retargeting. Only actually perceived consequences enter the controller observation record.
sharedRules.ready: Use the accepted Ready contract unchanged: Action at preparation, actual spell paid/cast/components/cadence/counter window once; one held spell requiring concentration until release/expiry; expiration before next regular own-start refresh. Choose targets/area at a legal Reaction release and recheck prerequisites. Illegal/declined releases do not spend a Reaction and may wait until expiry. Release creates no second cast or payment and anchors the effect duration then. Wail NEW audible death-bearing emission occurs at release, distinct from its preparatory V component; a physically voice-blocked release is ineligible. Casting menus/save-load/mode changes grant no turn, release, death save, reaction or clock reset.
